title: Myspace eyes comeback as an an 'antidote' to social media fatigue — but it may be a long shot
summary: Myspace is attempting a comeback as consumers seek alternatives to mainstream social media platforms dominated by algorithmic feeds. The potential revival is driven by nostalgia for a less algorithm-driven internet era, though industry experts remain skeptical about its long-term viability.
content: "Excitement about Myspace's relaunch reflects nostalgia for a more analog time, when algorithms were less dominant in our lives," an analyst told CNBC.

zh.title: Myspace 欲卷土重来成"社交媒体疲劳"的解药——但这可能遥遥无期
zh.summary: 随着消费者寻求摆脱主流社交媒体平台的算法推荐束缚，Myspace 正在尝试卷土重来。这次潜在的复兴是由人们对过去不那么算法驱动的互联网时代的怀念所推动的，尽管业界专家对其长期生存能力仍持怀疑态度。

title: Verizon mobile service restored after outage for thousands of customers in the U.S.
summary: Verizon restored mobile service following an outage affecting thousands of U.S. customers; the carrier recommends device restarts for ongoing issues but has not disclosed the outage's cause. This highlights carrier reliability and the importance of customer communication during service disruptions.
content: Customers still having trouble with their service should restart their devices, the wireless carrier said. Verizon did not provide ⁠a reason for ⁠the outage.

zh.title: Verizon 在美国数千客户的服务中断后恢复移动服务
zh.summary: Verizon 在影响数千美国客户的服务中断后恢复了移动服务；运营商建议重启设备以解决持续问题，但尚未披露中断原因。这突显了运营商可靠性和服务中断期间客户沟通的重要性。
